worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.summary: The user tips its head back for several deep gulps: the heal arrives in portions for about half of maximum health, and the last gulp washes away poison. It can keep moving while drinking, but every gulp costs a few breaths; an unfinished drink (cancelled or interrupted) keeps only what was already drunk and never cures early.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.use.0: Take the heal in several gulps
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.use.1: Wash off poison along the way
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.use.2: Worth using even at full health while poisoned
Drinks %2$s gulps, one every %3$s, restoring %1$s of maximum health in total; the last gulp washes away poison.
Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s, shortened by Speed; the user can keep moving while drinking.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.stance.warm: Warm milk: +0.05 healing and a 1.3x gulp interval (drunk slowly), at the cost of a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.stance.cold: Chilled milk: -0.03 healing, a 0.8x gulp interval and a shorter cooldown - quick sips for a gap between blows.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.preference.w: On (warm): +0.05 healing and a 1.3x gulp interval (drunk slowly), at 1.08x cooldown. Off (chilled): -0.03 healing, a 0.8x gulp interval and 0.94x cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.milkdrink.preference.a: The companion drinks below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher drinks at the first wound. Poison overrides this threshold.

A visible enemy inside this distance, or attacking the companion, stops it from starting a drink (poison or health under half the threshold ignores this); larger retreats further, smaller drinks amid the fight.
Each gulp only restores what is missing at that moment, so starting near full health yields less than the listed total; poison is washed away only when the last gulp is truly finished (cancelling or being interrupted keeps the drunk part and never cures early). It can be used while missing health or poisoned, and at full health while poisoned it still drinks through to the cure.
